title: Achieving Material Robustness via Symmetric Stress Finite Element Discretizations
summary: When discretizing symmetric stress tensors in variational problems arising in continuum mechanics, one has to choose how to enforce the symmetry of the stress tensor: (i) strongly by requiring the discrete tensors to be pointwise symmetric or (ii) weakly by introducing a Lagrange multiplier.
